user_reviews.Description:
Outstanding Experience with Nova Era!

Working with Nova Era has been an absolute pleasure from start to finish. Their team perfectly blends creativity, technical skill, and professionalism. They took the time to understand our brand, goals, and target audience — and the final website they delivered completely exceeded our expectations.

The design is sleek, modern, and user-friendly, and their digital strategy has already started driving more traffic and engagement for our business. Communication was seamless throughout the entire process, and every deadline was met right on schedule.

If you’re looking for a web design and digital creative agency that truly cares about quality and results, Nova Era is the team to trust. Highly recommend them to anyone who wants to elevate their online presence!

user_reviews.Description:

user_reviews.Name: Cevher Ersoy
user_reviews.Description:
i worked with Nova Era Agency, a San Francisco web design and SEO agency, to build a website for my online book business, and the experience has been outstanding. The site they designed looks great, is easy to use, and actually helps convert visitors into customers instead of just sitting there looking nice.

If you’re looking for a reliable web design and SEO agency in San Francisco, especially for an e-commerce or online business, I highly recommend Nova Era Agency.

user_reviews.Name: Xperia Hotels
user_reviews.Description:
Nova Era completely rebuilt our hotel website and delivered outstanding work. They understood our business, our guest profile, and what we wanted to highlight better than anyone we worked with before. The result is a clean, modern, fast, and very well-structured website that reflects our brand perfectly.

Their communication was exceptional. I could reach them anytime, and they always responded quickly with clear solutions. The team is highly professional and truly knows what they’re doing, especially when it comes to Google’s system and SEO. They guided us step by step on how to position the site for better visibility, and it made a real difference.

Overall, a great experience from start to finish. Reliable, talented, and absolutely worth recommending.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lawrence Arevalo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Well, first of all, I found Smack Happy on Yelp. Which is important to me to see the other customer reviews. There are so many design firms out there that it's hard to cut through the clutter. A Google search of "website design San Francisco" would yield too many results so I would need to rely on yelp or a personal reference, and even a personal reference would need to be vetted in some way.

Smack Happy stood out on Yelp because it seems like there was a lot of positive feedback, but most important to me you seemed to be one of the only graphic design firms that worked on their own brand and image. Most other companies have a horrible webpage, and they seem to have worked on theirs as much as they would for your best client. For me, that really said that they cared about what you do. The old adage of "The Cobbler's Children have no shoes" seemed like a cop out for most of the other companies not to do well for themselves what they claim to do well for others.

The other thing that stood out once I was on your website was their actual work you had done for other clients. The designs were bold, playful, and had touches of uniqueness that personalized every site that I saw. I was happy that every site didn't look like a recycled template that you had used and just plugged in info for every new client. Their work is really good and there were only a few companies at theirr level that do work as well as you. I actually got 2 other quotes after meeting with Nicole and both were similarly priced.

During the shopping phase the communication with Nicole was easy, warm, and energetic. The meetings in her office were great and she is such a kind person who is really invested in the work that she does for each client and that's apparent. THANK YOU!!

I came to Nicole with hacking issues. She really is great at what she does. She's super helpful in teaching someone how to do stuff on their own, she handles the stuff that I don't want to deal with, and is great about getting things done in a speedy manner.

THANK YOU! (A million times over)

user_reviews.Name: cavan wong
user_reviews.Description:
Quick summary - responsive until they received my full payment, then no progress after 1 full year.

As a small business in San Francisco, we wanted an updated web site just for company info and pictures. Jason had quoted a quick turnaround - 2 weeks for a logo re-design and a total of 6 weeks for the web site to go live.

1/31/2023 - received a quote from Jason at Voco Design
2/1/2023 - I accepted the quote and paid my 50% deposit
2/9/2023 - logo re-design delivered and accepted
3/8/2023 - web site mock ups delivered and accepted
4/12/2023 - invoiced for remaining 50% and paid it

The following steps is when everything broke down
Between May and June of 2023, either myself or Jason was out of town/country, so we could not finalize.

8/2/2023 - Jason requested access to my web hosting server to start uploading. I have not seen any changes to my web site at all.

Since then, I have not been able to get a commitment from Jason or his team. Jason has sent me messages saying he was out of town, medical emergencies, etc which I can totally understand and was willing to wait for him.  I had called his office and Tom had responded to look into it, but I have now been ignored by Tom as well.

As of 2/1/2024 (one year later!!), I have sent an email to Jason and Tom to just close the project. They can refund me some portion of my 100% paid job, but they have not responded. I have changed the password to my web hosting as a precaution.

I am willing to call this a loss and mark it as a lesson learned working with design companies. Maybe my company was too small for them, but seems my money was good enough for them

8/2/2023 - Jason requested access to my web hosting server to start uploading. I have not seen any changes to my web site at all.

Jason has sent me messages saying he was out of town, medical emergencies, etc which I can totally understand and was willing to wait for him.  I had called his office and Tom had responded to look into it, but I have now been ignored by Tom as well.

As of 2/1/2024 (one year later!!), I have sent an email to Jason and Tom to just close the project. They can refund me some portion of my 100% paid job, but they have not responded. I have changed the password to my web hosting as a precaution.

I am willing to call this a loss and mark it as a lesson learned working with design companies. Maybe my company was too small for them, but seems my money was good enough for them

user_reviews.Description:
When it comes to building quality websites, delivering professional service and offering insightful advice, Kegan comes second to none. I can't say enough about how much his help and "touch ups" on my site improved my business. When you bump into guys that look like he does on the street, you'd think they were not that sharp or just a space cadet. Kegan couldn't be further from that persona. All tangents aside, you won't find a better web designer/developer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Stiarwalt
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the owners of our Auto Repair shop used to work for a Doctor's office where they used DF for all of their scheduling needs. She loved it so much that when they opened their Auto Repair business she implemented it into their shop.  Since I have been working with it (over the past 6 years) it's had some ups and downs. I use it mainly for marketing and I have really liked it for that purpose. It's easy, allows me to add my own art, design my own email blasts and is pretty intuitive. There are definitely some tweaks that need to be made but overall, it's pretty good. As for scheduling, it serves its purpose. I'm not sure if our issues are because we don't know how to use it properly or if it's just not the best setup for an Auto Repair shop.  Anytime I have had an issue, DF is quick to connect me with a service rep. My current rep has been absolutely fantastic. He's extremely responsive and has conducted 1 on 1 training sessions in every area I've inquired about.  I had issues in the past with reps responding in a timely manner, but for now that seems to be worked out. The reason for the 3 stars is that there are some seemingly simple requests I've made for changes to our online scheduling portal and the marketing options, but I don't have any confidence these changes will ever be granted. Also, after all of these years, we still need additional software to make our shop scheduling and customer communications run smoothly. If DF had it all, we wouldn't need more. If I could, I would rate it 3.5 stars; settled on 3 because 4 is too much.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Hayes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Demandforce has left me completely at a loss for words, almost. A software company that does not have your best interest as a business. I was sold on an idea that they would reach out to our customer base to keep them informed and interested. At the beginning our clients were hounded by text messaging telling them to come in, we haven't seen you in a long time. However, the clients would have just come in a few days or week before. They were given wrong information regarding their appointments, they were also sent discount letters and birthday gifts that were not authorized. Even the name they were using for our company wasn't accurate. We continued to reach out to the Demandforce team and were told excuses, but nothing was ever fixed. We just had to apologize to our clients and tell them just to ignore the messages. Some of our clients asked to be taken off our list completely.  After 7 months of this I asked to cancel the service and then was told that they had a year agreement that I never signed or agreed to. The document that they sent to my credit card company was not my signature or my  intials. Demandforce is not only a company that is inept, but also a dishonest one. I would not do business with this company, ever.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tacylin Shinkle
user_reviews_extended.Description: After an hour tutorial conversation with Rebecca M. from the Demandforce team today, I would absolutely say the five star review is earned. The system itself is helpful and allows the veterinary clinic I manage to communicate with our clients better, but more importantly the amount of personal service and attention I've gotten has amazed me. There were so many useful features that my clinic was not taking advantage of, and today I was able to start understanding and utilizing those tools due to a clear, concise and personalized phone meeting with Rebecca. She even took the time to edit a custom logo to fit size specifications for our profile, and update our customer e-mails to look more current and on-brand. As these were all features included in our current subscription, I ended our conversation by asking what the motivation was. The answer I got was that Demandforce wants its clients to know the full value of their product, and to be sure each business is set up for success with the program. This is something I don't see enough in large companies like this, and I appreciate it so much. I look forward to my next talk with her so I can learn about how much more Demandforce can help us!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Kludac
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have to say, I am a huge fan of Demandforce! I own a hand car wash and detail shop called Detail Kings based outside of Chicago. I have been subscribing to Demandforce for about a year and it is a essential tool to run a great business. I love the fact that it integrates with my Quickbooks and it allows past and future customers interaction with my business. When a customer gets their car cleaned from us today, they receive a email tomorrow which allows them to write a review which I as the business owner look at as a report card for the service that was performed on their vehicle. We have generated hundreds of reviews that customers look at seeing it is also integrated with my webpage and found if you do a Google search under my business name.
I also love the fact that Demandforce will reach out to past customers that we haven't scene in a while via email and offer them a promotion to come and see us again automatically. I find my subscription to this essential tool being paid for by all the work the software does for my business. I love the product and wouldn't know what I would do without it!

Paul Kludac
Detail Kings Founder & CEO

user_reviews_extended.Description:

Demandforce is a very helpful tool that we really like.  They are a growing company and a constantly working on adding new features and do fun things to keep the their clients happy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: River Crossing Family Dental
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After being unsatisfied with the customer service and patient interactions with our previous automated patient confirmation and recall providers, DEMANDFORCE has been a dream come true! As an office manager being able to communicate with my patients by their preferred method has been AMAZING! begin able to send text messages to follow up or remind patients of pretreatment information has been great. My patients love that they can customize how to be communicated with. There were some who told me things like, watch out their customer service is bad, they take forever to get back to you, etc. BUT LET ME TELL YOU THE TRUTH, I have had nothing but the TOP in customer care and service since day one and through out the past 100 days. Not only by my assigned representative either, I have been able to call in to customer support and have a tech support agent call me back in minutes, the same tech support has been able to work on my server without me sitting on a phone while I have clients to tend to, I merely told them what my issue was, gave access to my server and then they took care of the rest and EVEN CALLED ME BACK TO LET ME KNOW IT WAS DONE & how they took care of the issue we were having. (an issue that was due to a practice system upgrade that I had forgot to notify DEMANDFORCE about, nothing to do with their side). In most companies if you need help they make you wait on hold to get to a representative who then makes you wait to be transferred to a tech who then makes you wait on the line while they work on the issue. All during a busy office day where you are needed else where, not with DEMANDFORCE, I was on the phone maybe 3 minutes the ENTIRE TIME.

Not to mention the amazing one on one customer support they give you while you are just starting up, HEATHER was awesome, funny, down to earth and very respectful of my limited availability, finding days to work around my time restrictions. One day she wasn't able to be in the office due to illness and instead of just ignoring my scheduled appointment, her supervisor called me in her place and asked if I would like to reschedule or do the meeting with him. Since I am comfortable with Heather, I rescheduled but again they looked at what time worked for me. She was amazing at helping me find the right tone and creative look for my email campaigns and what works for me for recalls.

All I can say is they have done a truly amazing job helping this business!

--River Crossing Family Dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: Animal Farm Pet Hospital Sf
user_reviews_extended.Description: My name is Mayra and I am the office manager at Animal Farm Pet Hospital in San Francisco. Meeting Amina was really a rewarding experience. I did not have much knowledge of Demandforce and its benefits as a user. Amina was kind enough to make her time and go over the amazing things that Demandforce can offer to make a more "at ease" experience with our clients. What I love about Demandforce is the hassle free and worry free appointment reminders along with vaccine/flea/annual exam reminders. No more calling clients or mailing out reminders! Unlike other review websites, Demandforce helps our clients point out not only the negative/opinion but both the negative and positive from there visits. Plus, the reviews our clients provide help us as a hospital improve and continue to motivate us as a veterinary hospital to provide excellent customer service.  Since I was introduced to the campaign option, we have seen an increase with patient preventative care and client communication. We would absolutely recommend Demandforce for any business looking to increase clientele and revenue. Amina was kind enough to show me how to run the 20/20 campaign, in just a 24 hour period, we had over 7 appointment requests! Using these types of campaigns really helps motivate our clients in providing preventative care to their pets.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony Aldana
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have nothing but great things to say about Demandforce.
From the time I met Amina to the time we went live I felt we were in good hands.  Amina was the person that got me excited about the program. She explained everything so well and was so enthusiastic about the program that that enthusiasm, made me excited about the program. So if you have a chance to speak with her, I would take that call.
We started using DemandForce about 6 weeks ago. Since then, we have increased our Google reviews from 2 to 55. AMAZING!!!!The problem we were having was trying to get clients to write a review for us. We tried everything from giving them a $10 off coupon to even giving them a free exam, but nothing seemed to work.
We would bend over backwards all the time to help our clients out of difficult situations, such as financial constraints, especially during the recession. We would end up giving away free services because they didn’t have any money and all we would ask in return was to just write a review and to my amazement, nothing.
That’s why when I saw how many reviews DemandForce had gotten for us; I knew they had perfected the process of getting a client to write a review.
The way they do it, is by sending them an email within an hour of the appointment while everything is fresh in their minds.  Nowadays everyone has a smart phone so they can right the review right then and there.
The other thing I was amazed by was the promotions they offer to get clients back in the door. The one that worked best for us so far was giving our clients $20 off of an exam to the first 20 people that called. We ended up making 25 appointments that day because the clients had to make the appointment by that day because the offer was for that day only. BRILLIANT!!!!!
Clients also compliment us on how we send out text messages to confirm their appointments.
DemandForce has definitely taken us to the next level of service and I’m proud to be a member.
Sincerely,
Tony Aldana

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I like Demandforce because it makes communicating with our clients easy and that’s AWESOME!  As the owner of Stoney Creek Veterinary Hospital, I feel proud that we have 171 glowing Google reviews from our happy clients.  It feels really nice to see what our clients think and feel about us online.  We are an AAHA accredited hospital and take pride in the quality of medicine we practice but our online reputation was minimal before Demandforce.  I personally believe that Reviews lead to new business and it’s important that a successful hospital has these reviews to reflect their reputation.  With Demandforce our online reputation matches who we really are….. what more can you ask for as a business owner?

We took all of our ad dollars out of the yellow pages years ago because no one uses the yellow pages anymore.  Demandforce is interactive, we can change things around.  You can’t do that with the yellow pages.  We basically were stuck with our ad for the year.  Also, I think I was missing out on a huge group of clients who love to email and text - Demandforce makes it convenient for them to stay in touch with us as well as for us to keep in touch with them.
I would highly recommend Demandforce to any hospital that wants to grow and be successful. And, my experience with Amina has been wonderful - she works with me and my staff to create great health campaigns and listens to my needs.  Thank you Demandforce!
Jennifer F Johnson, VMD, CVPP
Stoney Creek Veterinary Hospital, Morton, PA

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marlene Hvc
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If I could give this company 0 stars I would.  Our original sales rep told us about all of the amazing things Demandforce could do for our business for $300/month.  We have 2 locations that share a common database.  Once we signed our contract the tech team said we had to have two separate accounts to use the product, so now $600/month.    Toward the end of our contract I contacted our Sales Rep to find out how to cancel, as we didn't want to continue with Demand Force . She did not return my phone calls or emails.  After a 3 weeks of no response, I contacted customer service.  They stated that we had missed the deadline to cancel the automatic renewal of our contract even with the time stamped emails I sent to the rep.

Our experience has gone down hill since them.  Every time we've had an issue we get the run around.  They have offered better products that are more cost effect for our 2 practices but after multiple emails with no response, I called and was told we weren't eligible until our contract was up.

Once we sent through notice of cancellation we were contacted by several "helpful" people telling us how they could show us how to better utilize the product.  Where were they when we asked for their help early on?  We asked to extend our contract a few months to try the new "suggestions".  The extension was completely misrepresented and was once again a deceptive technique to get us to sign a 1 year contract. These people will do anything they can to pass the buck around their company and make sure that you are stuck with their program.  We have jumped through every hoop only to find that there is something else we didn't do to cancel our contract in time.  We have now been fighting for the last 5 months to get our account closed.  Demand Force is a company with absolutely no integrity or ethics.  They have trained their employees to do everything they can to keep the money coming in by conveniently delaying return calls and emails or omitting important information.  This company can't be trusted and I would certainly look at other marketing companies for your needs.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Overall, Demandforce is AWESOME!!!  My brother and I own an independent auto repair shop in MA.  We've been using Demandforce as our primary follow-up system for our current customer database for almost 3 years...The ROI has been PHENOMENAL and I've already referred several other auto repair shops to them!

The reason I didn't give them a full 5 Stars is that there are several areas of the system that I would like to see more customization options:  I am trying to be extremely efficient in our marketing and I'd really like the option to segment the customer database so that I can tailor campaigns to specific groups of customers based on their demographic and psycho-graphic profiles...even though there are some workarounds that could allow you to do this, it's not easy to do...I would like to see it integrated into the system so it would be easy.  There are several other minor issues that I'd like to see improved also, but I don't have time to go into them here.

Regardless of the few improvements that I'd like to see, the system runs automatically in the background and provides amazing ROI results and at the end of the day, that's what it's all about!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Lamping
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Don't sign a contract with this company!  They are only interested in their  welfare and not your own!   There is a reason why they have so many poor reviews. If I treated my clients the way DemandForce has treated me, I wouldn't have a 5-star reputation either!

I opened a startup veterinary hospital and signed a contract with DemandForce in late 2013 after being introduced by a rep in my industry.  I felt that my initial experience was positive with an engaged reliable sales rep available to train us and answer questions about using the program.  When she left that position 5 months later, everything changed.  I no longer found the company's service to be responsive, having to wait 30-45 minutes on hold just to speak with someone.  We left messages with our account manager but it would take days to hear back from him.   I began to question my choice of service provider but elected to proceed as I was under a 12 month contract.  Unfortunately I missed the contract cancellation deadline and my experience since then has been horrendous!  I have been through 4 different "account managers" in 1.5 years with the company.  Seems they have difficulty keeping employees.  If they treat them anything like the way they treat their customers, I can see why they'd leave.

Every time I want to discuss cancellation I am sent to a sales rep "coach" who tries to convince me to stay.  When I ask to cancel, they can't help me.  When I ask to speak with billing, I am told they will call me.  Which they don't, they just e-mail me to say I have to pay out the contract for another 10 months.
When I call back, they want to pair me with a sales coach again who has no power to help me cancel the contract.
They auto-renew your policy WITHOUT COURTESY NOTICE and absolutely will not let you out of it should you miss the window!  Intuit knows that I cannot get out of the contract and they are dragging me through this.
I hate it and they are losing many future customers due to this.  I cannot tell you how many other vets, consultants, and other professionals I have told to steer clear of this company!  Until my contract expires, I will continue to tell as many colleagues as I meet that they avoid DemandForce.
If you are determined to use DemandForce, do not make the same mistake I did.  Refuse to sign any contract that auto-renews. Demand a month-to-month clause after the 1st year.  As for me, I'm taking my business elsewhere where professional customer service is a company core value.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Ewing
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Our experience with Demandforce started out great. Most of the representatives we worked with for the set up were attentive and exceptional with their customer service.

Unfortunately, Demandforce experienced a major technical issue in September with regards to Intuit Sync Manager being discontinued causing several customers including us to not sync properly with their system. As a result, no review generating e-mails were sent out to our customers. After three months of trying to resolve, numerous follow ups with their staff with several weeks inbetween answers, and hours of their technical team logged on to our computer to try and resolve, their technical team came back and said their system can no longer sync the same way (to a customer's main account and not sub accounts) and are unable to pull information from Quickbooks to send the reviews. Being an HVAC company we operate heavily on sub accounts since many of our customers have multiple properties. Without getting too indepth into the technical reasons, no acceptable alternative solutions were available.

Since they could not perform the service that we specifically needed, we are in the process of severing connections with them. While I am thankful they were graceful enough to let us out of their contract; sadly, they refuse to reimburse us for the lengthy three months of lost services while their technical team tried to work out a solution and in the end could not. This we find to be unexceptable. Their system did not work after their "update" and their team did not respond in a timely manner.

While I am thankful they were graceful enough to let us out of their contract; sadly, they refuse to reimburse us for the lengthy three months of lost services while their technical team tried to work out a solution and in the end could not. This we find to be unexceptable. Their system did not work after their "update" and their team did not respond in a timely manner.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Cushing
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've had a mixed experience with DF.  Initially and for several years they did what they said they'd do and we had a great relationship - until I decided to go with another provider, then the problems started.

When you try to cancel the service they just will not allow you to do that without multiple attempts to recover the account.  I guess I'd do the same - up to a point.  Then I'd have to say it may be worse to continue to press the case - sometimes no just means NO.

Stopping the billing is another matter.  They will continue to bill you after you've ended the relationship - contract or not!  DF will not accept billing telephone calls but makes you write emails to the billing department that in my case were never answered.  Finally I had to dispute the charges with my bank to get the money back.  Not too customer friendly I'd say.  DF may be right for you if you know going in if you accept getting out is quite a hassle.

user_reviews.Name: David M
user_reviews.Description:
My company recently partnered with Spiral Scout to help clarify our vision and build our website. Our initial conversations were with John, Spiral Scout's CEO, who immediately understood our project and answered many, many questions with patience and professionalism. We then collaborated with Spiral Scout's Business Analyst to consider the logic and flow of our site, particularly related to our plans for automated tasks. This all took place prior to the Project Manager and Web Developers beginning work and we benefited greatly from this phase of the project. The Business Analyst and Project Manager helped us consider issues that would have cost us considerably had we not caught them in the beginning. user_reviews.Name: Sam Gencer
user_reviews.Description:
We worked with this company for around 4 months. We had two scheduled meetings per month. Several times, when we joined a meeting just 1–2 minutes late, they canceled the meeting and postponed it by two weeks. We clearly asked them not to do this and to proceed at the scheduled time. This continued anyway.

After another meeting was canceled due to a 2-minute delay, I decided to stop working with them.

About 20 days later, we noticed that our meta titles had been blocked. We were never informed. During those 20 days, we experienced serious traffic and business loss, which directly affected revenue.

This situation caused major stress and damage to our business. We looked into legal action and spent over $20,000 just on preparation. We were later advised that completing the case could cost up to $400,000, so we had to stop.

Based on our experience, this was a very risky and harmful partnership. I would strongly recommend being extremely careful before giving this company control over critical SEO assets.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Muhammad Salem
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been advertising with SFOM Marketing for over 10 years, investing a significant amount of money into my PPC account. Unfortunately, my experience has been nothing short of disappointing
When I decided to part ways with them, they initially refused to give me access to my PPC account, which contains crucial historical data about my keywords, company optimizations, and funding. This lack of access has negatively impacted my business ranking, which I had maintained for years thanks to my investment.
While they eventually returned my Google My Business profiles after a lengthy struggle, they still withheld my PPC account. Their refusal to address my questions about advertising strategies, growth, and Al has shown a lack of accountability. It feels like they operate with a "do no wrong" attitude and are unwilling to engage in constructive dialogue.
Furthermore, they have become increasingly greedy, charging for services that should be included in their management. For instance, despite paying a third party for website development, they refused to optimize my new site without additional charges. They also charged for Yelp ad management but provided no value--anyone can create a Yelp business account directly. The same goes for Local Service Ads; they charged me an additional 20% for something I could easily do myself.
If you're considering advertising with SFOM Marketing, I strongly advise ensuring you maintain full control of your business assets. My experience has been fraught with challenges and frustration, and I regret the years I spent with them.

user_reviews.Description:
I have been working with 6S for a 2+ years now and can't say enough good things about them.  They worked closely with my graphic designer and IT vendor on a rebrand project and put together an outstanding website.  Launch was seamless, smooth, and on-time.  Since then, they have been proactive with managing the website and SEO, and our results have been outstanding.  I get more traffic now than I ever did with my previous vendor (a major outfit) and for lower cost.  6S delivers.

Perhaps just as importantly, 6S gives me useful, actionable, objective advice.  Not an upsell.  If I have a question, we have a call or videoconference by the next business day.  If I don't need something, they tell me.  If something isn't working, they tell me.  If there is something I do need, but they don't offer it, they refer me to someone they trust.  I recommend them to anyone, without reservations.

user_reviews.Name: Fred Parvini (Solution21)
user_reviews.Description:
We are a full-service marketing agency, and over the years we’ve designed and developed more than 2,000 websites for dentists, doctors, and a wide range of other businesses. In addition to web design, we manage Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and offer a variety of other marketing services across multiple industries. As we began taking on more website redesign and website migration projects, such as moving sites from WordPress to Webflow, many clients started experiencing drops in organic traffic and SEO keyword rankings after their migrations. To address this, we brought in RiseOpp for support.

Kaveh, the founder of RiseOpp, trained our entire website design and development team on the essential principles required to preserve SEO rankings during a migration. This training involved thorough processes using SEO tools like Screaming Frog, maintaining consistent URLs, meta information, and other key elements throughout the transition, and performing careful verification once the migration was complete. After applying these guidelines, the issue was resolved entirely, and our clients’ SEO performance even improved thanks to the enhanced user experience of their redesigned sites.

We also partnered with RiseOpp as a white-label provider for SEO services for many of our own clients. They worked with roughly 20 of our customers, primarily doctors and dentists, over several years and consistently delivered outstanding SEO results with excellent satisfaction. Their work included acquiring high-quality backlinks, executing content marketing strategies, producing comprehensive blog posts, managing local SEO, conducting keyword research, and performing both technical SEO and on-page optimization.

I highly recommend RiseOpp to individual clients as well as agencies. Their team is outstanding, and they excel in every area of SEO.

user_reviews.Name: Chrystal Griffin
user_reviews.Description:
We've worked with the RiseOpp team in San Francisco for several years now. When we first started scaling our marketplace, we knew we needed a long-term SEO strategy that was both technically sound and able to grow with us. The RiseOpp team has consistently gone above and beyond in every aspect of on-page and technical SEO.

They conducted weekly technical SEO audits, helped us resolving issues, improved PageSpeed scores, fixed mobile friendliness problems, and continually monitored and interpreted our ranking data and movements. Their deep expertise in technical SEO has been critical in helping us maintain site health at scale. They were proactive in identifying strategies to stay on top of ranking fluctuations with actionable insights.

On the on-page SEO side, they helped optimize hundreds of pages for better keyword targeting, internal linking and more. They did a fantastic job of helping us strategically approach content structure in a way that aligned with both search intent and user experience. Their recommendations were always data-driven, clearly explained, and prioritized based on expected impact.

One of the most impressive things about the RiseOpp team is their consistency and long-term dedication.  They have supported us through multiple site updates, ranking shifts, Google algorithm changes, and product launches. Their communication is excellent, and they always come to the table with solutions rather than just reporting problems.

If you’re looking for a trusted SEO partner that truly understands technical SEO, on-page optimization, Google Search Console insights, mobile performance, indexing issues, PageSpeed optimization, and long-term organic strategy, I highly recommend the RiseOpp team. user_reviews_extended.Name: Fred Parvini (Solution21)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We are a full-service marketing agency, and over the years we’ve designed and developed more than 2,000 websites for dentists, doctors, and a wide range of other businesses. In addition to web design, we manage Google Ads, Facebook Ads, and offer a variety of other marketing services across multiple industries. As we began taking on more website redesign and website migration projects, such as moving sites from WordPress to Webflow, many clients started experiencing drops in organic traffic and SEO keyword rankings after their migrations. To address this, we brought in RiseOpp for support.

Kaveh, the founder of RiseOpp, trained our entire website design and development team on the essential principles required to preserve SEO rankings during a migration. This training involved thorough processes using SEO tools like Screaming Frog, maintaining consistent URLs, meta information, and other key elements throughout the transition, and performing careful verification once the migration was complete. After applying these guidelines, the issue was resolved entirely, and our clients’ SEO performance even improved thanks to the enhanced user experience of their redesigned sites.

We also partnered with RiseOpp as a white-label provider for SEO services for many of our own clients. They worked with roughly 20 of our customers, primarily doctors and dentists, over several years and consistently delivered outstanding SEO results with excellent satisfaction. Their work included acquiring high-quality backlinks, executing content marketing strategies, producing comprehensive blog posts, managing local SEO, conducting keyword research, and performing both technical SEO and on-page optimization.

I highly recommend RiseOpp to individual clients as well as agencies. Their team is outstanding, and they excel in every area of SEO.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bethy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
IDF Studio and specifically our designer Blaire Schenck transformed our home in 2025.

We found IDF online and liked what we saw on their web site. Their interior design work was so tasteful and made such great use of color; it really appealed to us! We contacted them and soon had an initial phone call with the founder and CEO, Kassin Adelman. Soon after, everything started unfolding nicely. We contacted them in June last year and the project was 98% finished just before Thanksgiving.

Blaire was assigned our project and we had the best time working with her. We wanted work done on the whole interior, except the kitchen and bathrooms. She asked us a lot of questions to get to know us and she and another staff member (Callie) took measurements (tons of measurements) to be used for CAD drawings. We had a few Zoom meetings where Blaire shared initial and then more developed designs with us. We received documents to approve purchases (that they handled). We used their recommended contractor (R5, Emerson Duque) for painting and lighting upgrades, fireplace remodel, new closet doors, etc. The contractor and his team were the best we've ever worked with.

Blaire's designs were amazing. So beautiful and fun and unique to us. We are big fans of music and cycling and color and art. Blaire worked these themes into our home so beautifully! Her design and use of our art and photos was spectacular. We have to mention her emails- they were wonderful. So complete and full of ideas and options and explanations. And always kind and positive (and funny!).

We went into the project a little unclear as to how much we would need to spend, and also unclear as to the scope of our project. We had an initial budget in mind but wound up going over. However, what we got was so worth it. We have no qualms whatsoever about increasing our budget to get such nice work done. Lara in purchasing was also amazing to work with. Just like Blaire- always helpful and cheerful and responsive.

We are extremely happy we hired IDF Studio to turn our home into a space so unique and beautiful. Check out their web site and find a home in their portfolio that speaks to you, and let them know. For us it was their "Jackson Street" project. 100% recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Ming Wood
user_reviews.Description:
Nastaran, Dane, LeeAnne and the rest of the team are incredibly good at what they do.
We decided we were out of our depth designing and constructing our first coffee shop/roastery from a full teardown and build out so we reached out to Studio BANAA for help. They provided exceptional care and attention to details managing the entire design process, architecture, construction and final touches which allowed us to go from concept to fully functional shop in an incredibly short time!

Anytime we had feedback or ideas to incorporate to better represent our brand, they took the time to spin up new ideas and work with us to get our vision represented in an authentic way. The result is incredibly refined and landed us in journal articles for Café buildouts from prominent publications.

When it came time to contractors and finding technical solutions to unique problems, they always had a talented and reliable contact or product in mind. Anything that came up, they were present and helping us find a fast resolution at the best price possible which we really appreciated.

If you want to build something truly special and unique you will not find a more competent team than Studio BANAA.

user_reviews.Name: Matthew Hemington
user_reviews.Description:
Working with Architect and Design Firm EAG studio on our Russian Hill penthouse remodel has been nothing short of extraordinary. From start to finish, they completely transformed our space into the perfect city pied-à-terre we envisioned, making the most of the bridge to bridge view, one that is not only stunning and unique but also incredibly functional. They made use of every square inch of the space, ensuring no detail was overlooked and that every corner had purpose and intention.
The collaboration between the team- ourselves, the builders, the subs, the vendors and the design team—was seamless throughout the entire process. EAG studio fostered an open, communicative environment where every idea was heard, and their ability to coordinate all moving parts with such precision was truly impressive. They brought together form, function, and creativity in a way that felt effortless, leaving us with a result that far exceeded our expectations. They obtained the building permit in record time and also presented the HOA to keep things smooth and easier for us, acting as our devoted advocate all along.
One of the most remarkable aspects of working with EAG Studio was their attention to detail. From reconfiguring the layout for maximum functionality to designing custom furniture and interiors that reflect our style and needs, their commitment to perfection was evident in every aspect of the project. They didn’t just redesign our penthouse; they reimagined it, creating a space that feels completely new yet entirely ours.
The custom interiors are a standout. Every piece of furniture and design element feels like it belongs, and the thoughtful touches make our home not only beautiful but a joy to live in. Their expertise and creativity brought our vision to life, and we couldn’t be happier with the results.
If you’re looking for a design team that delivers exceptional results while making the process collaborative, enjoyable, and stress-free, look no further than EAG Studio. They truly turned our dream into reality, and we couldn’t recommend them more highly!

From start to finish, they completely transformed our space into the perfect city pied-à-terre we envisioned, making the most of the bridge to bridge view, one that is not only stunning and unique but also incredibly functional. They made use of every square inch of the space, ensuring no detail was overlooked and that every corner had purpose and intention.
The collaboration between the team- ourselves, the builders, the subs, the vendors and the design team—was seamless throughout the entire process. EAG studio fostered an open, communicative environment where every idea was heard, and their ability to coordinate all moving parts with such precision was truly impressive. They brought together form, function, and creativity in a way that felt effortless, leaving us with a result that far exceeded our expectations. They obtained the building permit in record time and also presented the HOA to keep things smooth and easier for us, acting as our devoted advocate all along.
One of the most remarkable aspects of working with EAG Studio was their attention to detail. From reconfiguring the layout for maximum functionality to designing custom furniture and interiors that reflect our style and needs, their commitment to perfection was evident in every aspect of the project. They didn’t just redesign our penthouse; they reimagined it, creating a space that feels completely new yet entirely ours.
The custom interiors are a standout. Every piece of furniture and design element feels like it belongs, and the thoughtful touches make our home not only beautiful but a joy to live in. Their expertise and creativity brought our vision to life, and we couldn’t be happier with the results.
If you’re looking for a design team that delivers exceptional results while making the process collaborative, enjoyable, and stress-free, look no further than EAG Studio. They truly turned our dream into reality, and we couldn’t recommend them more highly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Connors
user_reviews_extended.Description: In 2011, my partner and I decided that it was time to renovate our Corona Heights home. Vin Leger was highly recommended to us by a mutual acquaintance and after seeing examples of his previous home projects, we quickly decided that he would be good fit for our renovation project. Our working relationship spanned two years. The first year or so was spent in design consultations as we refined concepts and ideas and discussed budgets and timelines. He listened to us carefully about what we wanted to accomplish with the renovation and always provided us with options and solutions. Our to-the-studs renovation took 10 months and Vin shepherded us through the entire process. He was always calm and collected and worked expertly with our general contractor. The final product was a well-designed modern home that reflected our own taste and style and realized by a highly skilled design professional. The house recently sold for 25% over asking because it looked so good.  We can’t recommend Vin highly enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Douglas Pace
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We have worked with Vin on both large and small design efforts through many years. In every case his vast experience, style, and knowledge has provided such incredible guidance that I honestly fear moving foward without his expertise.

Selfishly, we enjoy everything he has done for us. But at the same time, it has been a genuine joy to witness his creative potential displayed through so many other homes his hands have touched. It is in these larger scenarios (sometimes complete rebuilds) where his full capabilities are on open display, and the result is honestly both breath-taking and exciting as I picture the lives of those using these re-imagined spaces. He is an artist, and so many San Francisco real estate properties have been his canvas.

But even after the "wow" moment subsides, I am continually reminded of some fundamentals: He delivers this talent without arrogance, high-end style without ignoring your budget, and - perhaps best of all - this beautiful design without (ever) sacrificing usability and livability. Once all the (literal) dust settles, we are reminded daily that these decisions make such a tremendous difference to our daily lives, and such an important final component of the partnership. Thank you; thank you so much.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Vorres
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve worked with EAG Studio for over 15 years on three residential projects located in very different environments, namely on the Big Island of Hawaii, San Francisco, and Charleston, and have consistently been impressed by their ability to execute at a high level across varying constraints.

Each project required a different approach. In Hawaii, the focus was on climate-responsive design, incorporating tropical materials and indoor-outdoor living. In San Francisco, the challenge was navigating a complex permitting environment, including detailed planning review and strict building requirements. In Charleston, the project required alignment with historic district guidelines while still delivering a functional, modern home.

EAG handled each of these conditions effectively. Their permit and construction drawings were detailed and well-coordinated, which reduced ambiguity for contractors and helped avoid unnecessary delays during construction. They remained engaged throughout the build phase, addressing issues as they arose and ensuring consistency with the original design intent.

They also added value on the procurement side, helping streamline selections and providing practical input on value-engineering, balancing cost, durability, and design quality.

From a client standpoint, what stands out is their consistency and reliability over time. They listen carefully, adapt to feedback, and maintain a high level of follow-through across all phases of a project.

I would recommend EAG Studio to anyone looking for a design team that can manage both the creative and technical aspects of complex residential work.

user_reviews.Description: We worked with Studio Ahead on a complete refresh of our Berkeley Brown Shingle House and highly recommend them!! user_reviews.Name: Mike Ellis
user_reviews.Description:
I hired Noz and her team to lead the design for a complete remodel of my 2BD/2BR condo in San Francisco. Before hiring a designer, I had worked up some very rough design ideas, but I wanted a designer to “push the envelope” while also developing a cohesive aesthetic throughout the home. From our initial consultation, Noz worked really hard to understand what I wanted, and used that as a starting point for her own amazingly unique and creative ideas. My home has been transformed in a way quite different from what I originally expected, but very much in the spirit of what I was seeking from a comfort and design perspective. I couldn’t be happier with how the place turned out, thanks to Noz and her team!

From initial contact to the completion of the project, Noz and team were consistently enthusiastic, communicative, prompt and clear. We worked through three design proposals, and with each iteration a concept drawing was incredibly helpful in thinking about what the final space would look like. The process was super valuable for me – Noz definitely had incredible ideas but was also more than open to my feedback and always available to explain and/or balance her design choices in very practical terms. Noz and her team also selected new furniture throughout the home, some of which was initially outside my comfort zone, but ultimately really added the finishing touch to the overall vibe of the final space.

I’ll just add to what others have said here already: For all her obvious design talent and accolades, Noz listens to her clients, is extremely practical, and is super fun to work with. She brings not just amazing design ideas and concepts but also a healthy perspective on the realities of construction. We had to scramble a few times with costs, pandemic delivery timelines, and many of the usual construction-related delays, and she always had good, practical solutions, while keeping the final design in mind. I think it’s a rare combination and I would not hesitate to recommend Noz and her team!

user_reviews.Name: Lou Sassole
user_reviews.Description:
I purchased my first home which was in dire need of a make over. After much searching, I decided to hire Noz as she was highly recommended by a friend. Noz's work speaks for itself: gorgeous, functional, modern, and unconventional. I made an instant connection with Noz and fell in love with her design philosophy and aesthetic. I initially hired her for interior design, but was so pleased that I increased the work scope to include a kitchen remodel, bath remodel, and outdoor paint selection. Noz was flexible and able to work within my tight budget. She always delivered results ahead of schedule. Noz designs with the client's happiness in mind; not her ego. She was always eager for feedback and interested in what made me happy. I would always tell her that I don't really know what I want, but I know what I don't want...

I am still amazed out how well Noz listened and translated my ideas into a home that I love (and so do my friends, family, and neighbors)! I am extremely happy with the work that she's done for me and look forward to many more projects together. I enthusiastically recommend Noz Design.

user_reviews.Name: A. M.
user_reviews.Description:
We hired Noz to help us decorate our entire new 3BR/2BA condo, including a deck off the living room.  We interviewed three interior designers and it was clear from our first conversation that her client-centric approach and knowledge of pretty much everything (from obscure topics to everything design/architecture/furniture, etc...) was unparalleled.  Our decision to hire Noz was the best decision we could have made.

Noz was incredibly clear about her design process, listening to our ideas and mocking up various options for us to be able to see her designs come to life.  She was great about working within our budget and making trade-offs between higher-end and more reasonably-priced pieces.  She also encouraged us to make a few bold choices on darker walls, which -- as she assured us they would -- came out beautifully.

Noz was such a joy to work with and educated us along the way: she was our partner in crime in designing our dream home and we not only loved the outcome, but also really enjoyed the process.  We couldn't recommend her highly enough.

user_reviews.Name: Ashley Chay-Fairty
user_reviews.Description:
Having Noz be our guiding light through our first home design project was a true blessing in many ways. We purchased a new construction house in the Pacific Palisades and while the delivered finishes were well done, we wanted to make it a home that reflected our personal style. Knowing that our design preferences leaned conservative, we engaged Noz to push our boundaries and introduce design concepts and combinations that we would have otherwise never thought of ourselves.

The added challenge was to make our home child-friendly for our toddler and incoming twin infants. Noz consulted on every room in the house, and here are the highlights: (i) an incredible four-bunk bedroom for our children to grow up in, (ii) a finished entertainment basement with media built-ins that had to be designed with very specific measurements in mind to house a vinyl record collection, (iii) a formal living room that had to be highly conducive to Christmas decorating, including the reupholstering of two antique seating pieces and the re-tiling of a fireplace and (iv) installing wainscoting and custom wallpaper in our dining room.

From start to finish, Noz’s consultation on our six bedrooms and many other common spaces spanned about 5 months, during which she maintained constant contact, even during her personal vacation in Japan.

We have been very impressed with her taste, direction, professionalism and swiftness of execution. Above all, Noz had a deep respect for our stated design budget and at no point did we feel like we were compromising design integrity to make our budget work. She was encouraging during times when we were on the fence about certain choices, and professional during times when we weathered internal disagreements about what general direction to take. She took constructive criticism of proposed mood boards very well and her reiterations were always closer to our vision.

We recommend Noz Design to anyone without reservation.

But beyond that, she is patient, calm, honest, and communicative - all important characteristics for  a designer to have during what can be a stressful time.

I interviewed and got quotes from 8+ different designers in San Francisco (and researched even more) and the decision to hire Noz was easy/instantaneous. Noz listened carefully to everything we were looking for, asked intentional questions, and delivered a proposal/contract that illustrated her attention to detail. For example, I casually mentioned that the new chair we needed for the living room needed to be dog friendly (our dog likes to sit and look out the window) and she remembered and included this detail in the proposal.

The project that Noz helped us with included: existing bathroom renovation, second bathroom and master closet addition, full condo paint consultation (Noz is a color consultant and made it SO easy to sort through the millions of color options that can be paralyzing), decor/furniture/fixture consultation, and partial kitchen renovation (we also removed a wall between kitchen and formal dining room to open up the space).

Noz went above and beyond what we expected. Beyond simply helping us design the agreed upon aspects of our place, she also made recommendations for small improvements/optimizations to our architectural plan that we are SO happy we listened to (examples: not building a permanent kitchen island that would have made it hard to move around in our space, not building in heated floors in our master bath that would have likely broken and cost us money over time to maintain, a better way to lay out the master bath/master closet space, and layout/spacing of our kitchen addition). Even after we completed our payment to her, Noz continued to respond to our texts/calls as questions came up (our project ended a few weeks later than anticipated). We just had our first baby a few weeks ago, and Noz reached out to check in and drop a gift off to us. Speaks volumes about how much she connects with and cares about her clients.

We had no idea how many decisions go into a renovation (beyond picking out fixtures/tile/hardware/furniture/etc, you have to decide on how to lay out the tile, where the hardware is positioned, heights of bathroom fixtures, etc). Having Noz there to call/text/consult gave us confidence in each of our choices. She does a fabulous job giving you all of the pros/cons and things to consider when making a decision and is ultimately always focused on helping you make the right call for you. She will also always give her opinion/recommendation when asked without being pushy. When it comes to furniture/fixture decisions, Noz is great at giving you a range of options at different price points within your budget so you can decide where and when to splurge v. where/when to save.

Noz was on the pricier end from an hourly cost perspective but ended up being on the more affordable end overall as she is much more efficient than other designers we spoke to (something she mentioned would be the case up front). Rooms that other designers said would take them 10-15 hours to design only took Noz a few hours - a reflection of her talent, knowledge and relationships. And she sticks to the # of hours she outlines in her contract so you know the cost up front with no surprises.

We are thrilled with the outcome of our project and feel like we gained a new space and a new friend. Strongly recommend Noz and her work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Ellis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I hired Noz and her team to lead the design for a complete remodel of my 2BD/2BR condo in San Francisco. Before hiring a designer, I had worked up some very rough design ideas, but I wanted a designer to “push the envelope” while also developing a cohesive aesthetic throughout the home. From our initial consultation, Noz worked really hard to understand what I wanted, and used that as a starting point for her own amazingly unique and creative ideas. My home has been transformed in a way quite different from what I originally expected, but very much in the spirit of what I was seeking from a comfort and design perspective. I couldn’t be happier with how the place turned out, thanks to Noz and her team!

From initial contact to the completion of the project, Noz and team were consistently enthusiastic, communicative, prompt and clear. We worked through three design proposals, and with each iteration a concept drawing was incredibly helpful in thinking about what the final space would look like. The process was super valuable for me – Noz definitely had incredible ideas but was also more than open to my feedback and always available to explain and/or balance her design choices in very practical terms. Noz and her team also selected new furniture throughout the home, some of which was initially outside my comfort zone, but ultimately really added the finishing touch to the overall vibe of the final space.

I’ll just add to what others have said here already: For all her obvious design talent and accolades, Noz listens to her clients, is extremely practical, and is super fun to work with. She brings not just amazing design ideas and concepts but also a healthy perspective on the realities of construction. We had to scramble a few times with costs, pandemic delivery timelines, and many of the usual construction-related delays, and she always had good, practical solutions, while keeping the final design in mind. I think it’s a rare combination and I would not hesitate to recommend Noz and her team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lou Sassole
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I purchased my first home which was in dire need of a make over. After much searching, I decided to hire Noz as she was highly recommended by a friend. I initially hired her for interior design, but was so pleased that I increased the work scope to include a kitchen remodel, bath remodel, and outdoor paint selection. user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Chay-Fairty
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Having Noz be our guiding light through our first home design project was a true blessing in many ways. We purchased a new construction house in the Pacific Palisades and while the delivered finishes were well done, we wanted to make it a home that reflected our personal style. Knowing that our design preferences leaned conservative, we engaged Noz to push our boundaries and introduce design concepts and combinations that we would have otherwise never thought of ourselves.

The added challenge was to make our home child-friendly for our toddler and incoming twin infants. Noz consulted on every room in the house, and here are the highlights: (i) an incredible four-bunk bedroom for our children to grow up in, (ii) a finished entertainment basement with media built-ins that had to be designed with very specific measurements in mind to house a vinyl record collection, (iii) a formal living room that had to be highly conducive to Christmas decorating, including the reupholstering of two antique seating pieces and the re-tiling of a fireplace and (iv) installing wainscoting and custom wallpaper in our dining room.

From start to finish, Noz’s consultation on our six bedrooms and many other common spaces spanned about 5 months, during which she maintained constant contact, even during her personal vacation in Japan.

We have been very impressed with her taste, direction, professionalism and swiftness of execution. Above all, Noz had a deep respect for our stated design budget and at no point did we feel like we were compromising design integrity to make our budget work. She was encouraging during times when we were on the fence about certain choices, and professional during times when we weathered internal disagreements about what general direction to take. She took constructive criticism of proposed mood boards very well and her reiterations were always closer to our vision.

We recommend Noz Design to anyone without reservation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: becky dodson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Our experience working with Noz was so exceptional that it's hard to know where to begin! My husband and I purchased our first home in October and expected our first child in February. Coming from a small apartment, we needed a lot of furniture and fast. Noz came in and was able to figure out our design sense, finding a perfect middle ground between my husband and I, and to work within our time constraints. She furnished our entire home by the time the baby arrived (within five short months!).

One of the most impressive aspects of working with Noz was her ability to find beautiful, high quality items within our budget. She truly respected our financial constraints, and had incredible judgment for when to splurge and when to save. I felt that she really listened to us, understood what we wanted, and provided us with far more personal attention than I ever could have expected. I don't think we were the easiest clients (my husband can be pretty... particular), but Noz was always very patient and flexible.

Noz has great instincts, but also the unique ability to articulate those instincts and explain her viewpoints. As much as Noz was able to quickly understand our taste, she was also able to challenge us to go beyond our comfort zones. Noz helped us choose several items that we never would have gravitated towards on our own and which have now become our favorite things! For example, she encouraged us to choose certain paint colors and lighting fixtures that consistently receive compliments from guests and truly made our house feel like our home.

The one room of the house that I wanted to tackle alone was the nursery, but even here I began to feel somewhat stuck and asked for Noz's input. She suggested we paint large, neutral stripes on the walls, which, again, we never would have considered on our own. The paint design completely elevated the nursery, and for all the other elements of the room that I love, it's the stripes that receive the wide-eyed admiration from guests. She just completely excels at turning the ordinary into something visually stunning, and in typical Noz fashion, she was able to do so within our budget and very quickly.

After even short absences, when we return to our house my husband and I are always struck by just how great it looks. It still surprises me that we were able to furnish our home so beautifully and so quickly, and it's all thanks to Noz. Putting the final product aside, she's also just a joy to work with-- fun and brilliant. My husband and I achieved the look we wanted for our home, but we also learned a lot and enjoyed the process. I cannot recommend Noz highly enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Bond
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Shortly after moving into our new home in San Francisco, we hired Noz to design several rooms for us. We’d interviewed several other designers, too, and Noz was by far the best able to understand the advantages of our space and how to use interior design to enhance it. She “got it” where others fell short.

Noz uses a business model that is uncommon among interior designers, where she charges based on her upfront time estimate, doesn’t bill for individual hours, and passes on her full designer discount. We felt that this model incentivized the kind of collaborative relationship that’s hard to realize under a more traditional hourly rate plus commission model (where every email and every round of back and forth costs more money). It’s now difficult for us to imagine doing it any other way.

Throughout the design process, Noz was extremely receptive to our feedback, adapting her designs significantly to meet our style, but also pushing us toward some stylish options she selected for us that we weren’t initially sure about but have grown to love. We’ve been extremely happy with the results!

Since completing the design phase of the project, Noz has been in touch regularly, and helped us navigate a couple of issues with vendors overcharging us or failing to deliver. She’s been incredibly helpful using her designer’s clout to lean on vendors to make things right, as well as suggesting some creative alternatives we’ve liked even better.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zara Mathew
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Choosing Noz as our designer for our new home is one of the best decisions we've made and I could not recommend her more highly.

When we first went searching for interior designers we were struck by how so many people produce very similar-looking work. Noz is distinctly not this type of designer. She oozes creativity and original thought in a way that is refreshing and inspiring. She is always creating spaces that are new and truly unique for her clients - rooms that meet their needs, echo their aesthetic spirit, and elevate the atmosphere of a home to heights that seem unimaginable. Noz did all of this for us and more. She took careful note of all our family's wants and needs, was patient with doing revisions to make everything perfect for us, and produced gorgeous results.

Noz was wonderful to work with in every way possible - she is kind and so genuinely likable. She won over and befriended my children immediately. She takes pride in her work but also balances a sense of humility, being willing to consider other viewpoints and incorporate them into her work when needed. She works hard and is reliable when it comes to timelines (something that is SO hard to find in this world!). She is militant in adhering to a budget and keeps track of orders, costs and all correspondence with impressive meticulousness. She reliably responds to all emails promptly. All of the people in Noz's orbit who she sent to our home to paint, to woodwork, to hang pictures, install furniture, etc. are like her--kind, talented and hardworking--we always know that anyone she vouches for will do great work for us. Noz cares deeply about everything she does but even more importantly genuinely cares about the people and the greater world around her - she is always looking for ways to do good and to use her talents and her platform to help others.

We are truly lucky to know Noz and to be able to work with her and now consider her a friend. Anyone who gets to work with Noz will certainly not regret the opportunity.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly White
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It was such a pleasure working with Noz on the remodeling of two bathrooms in our home! We love them and the design process was fun.

Noz was involved from beginning to end and was available to answer questions when we needed her. For one of the bathrooms, we weren't sure about where we wanted everything located. Noz provided us with several options, so we were able to sit with the options and consider the choices. Ultimately, we decided to go with the design she recommended.

Noz's designs were efficient in terms of space and very well-written for our understanding and use, as well as for the GC's and subcontractors' use. She listened so carefully to all of my functional and aesthetic goals for both bathrooms and always made recommendations in line with those goals. For example, I wanted as little grout in one shower as possible, and she recommended an excellent solution that looks fantastic and also requires very little upkeep. Her lighting suggestions look amazing in the spaces. Her suggestions for fixtures looked so perfect that it was easy to just say "yes!" to all of them. When we wanted to see fixtures and finishes in person, she referred us to various showrooms, which was also very helpful.

No construction project comes without hiccups, and we had one with a vendor. But thanks to Noz's excellent professional relationship with them, once she spoke with them, they quickly corrected course and expedited our order.

We can't wait to work with Noz again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Fang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've always aspired to have a place that is well put-together, that I would be proud to invite people over to enjoy. I've never had the ability nor really the opportunity, so when my boyfriend and I moved into a new one-bedroom apartment, I sought out Noz's help. She made this happen for us in a matter of weeks with an energy, professionalism, and true passion for the process that I have rarely seen.

One of the best parts of working with Noz was the comfort that she really understood what we wanted. Her forte is her ability to help her clients (who may not know themselves) what they prioritize and want in design and functionality. She begins by getting to know you and then constantly posing options to suss out what your preferences really are. She took the time to explain options to me, alternatives, was very knowledgeable about potential vendors, and was budget conscious throughout. She was also accommodating; I brought in a request to display books at a late stage in the process. She was able to very quickly build that into the layout without a fuss.

From the moment she walked into my kitchen and saw the lack of counter space (that I didn't realize would be an issue) to hanging my frames on a tough-to-nail wall, she has an eye for details and can really deconstruct and then problem solve a space to make it work.

I would definitely recommend her and hope I will have additional spaces for her to work with in the future. My boyfriend and I, having moved thousands of miles into an empty space, now have a place to call a home and we definitely thank Noz for that!

user_reviews_extended.Name: TJ Michels
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am a personal concierge, and I met Noz three years ago because we had a mutual client. I was blown away by her ability to lean into my client's eclectic taste and embrace the unique features of a historic home, yet still elevate the interior design with her own remarkable aesthetic.

The result landed my client's kitchen and living room in a Sunset Magazine spread.

Since strong referrals create something of an ecosystem, my clients have since overlapped with those of Noz. It has been a privilege to take a front-row seat to her designs in action, from the concept stage to completion. Her interiors are accessible, sophisticated, and beyond imaginative. She is a boundary pusher and a shapeshifter, and it's further a joy to witness our mutual clients' growing awe of their own homes.

As an aside, it is so easy to work with her, be it the mundane (coordinating furniture receiving) or the trickier stuff (contractor management).

I lack the words to describe her style, but I keep coming back to "bar none."

user_reviews.Name: Danielle Lazier
user_reviews.Description:
As a San Francisco listing agent agent, I've worked with many home stagers over the years, but Mayo Molnar and Studio Goldfinch Home Staging consistently exceed expectations. Mayo's exceptional eye for design, coupled with his "get it done" approach, has been instrumental in the success of countless home sales across San Francisco.

What sets Mayo apart in the competitive world of home staging is his unique combination of design expertise and practical problem-solving abilities. There's never any drama – just solutions, professionalism, and results. His ability to transform properties that captivate potential buyers is truly remarkable.

In San Francisco's demanding real estate market, pre-sale home preparations and professional home staging isn't just an option – it's essential for achieving premium results. Mayo understands this implicitly. His thoughtful enhancements and staging create the kind of aspirational yet livable spaces that photograph beautifully and drive buyer interest. The end result? Packed open houses and properties that consistently sell faster and for higher prices than expected.

While my negotiation and networking skills certainly play a role in securing top dollar for my listings, I can't emphasize enough how crucial Mayo's pre-sale staging is to the entire process. His work creates the vital first impression that gets buyers through the door and helps them envision their future home. In a market where being "best in class" is essential, Mayo and Studio Goldfinch consistently deliver the competitive edge that sellers need.

For anyone selling a home in San Francisco, I cannot recommend Mayo Molnar highly enough. His professionalism, efficiency, and design talent make him an invaluable partner in the home selling process.

user_reviews.Name: Ashish Arora
user_reviews.Description:
I have worked with Mayo Molnar and Studio Goldfinch for over a year now. I had purchased a Very nice condo in the Mission District in San Francisco. The place is very modern, and I wanted someone to help me with designing my new home. I have a modern aesthetic and wanted to design something modern while making it somewhat warm and homey.

Mayo and Studio Goldfinch have been amazing thru this journey. From the initial mood boards to sourcing items to project managing things, Mayo has been incredible. He is talented, listened closely to what I was looking for, met me dozens of times, walked stores in Design District with me and ultimately over delivered on my expectations.

Mayo has an exceptional taste when it comes to interior design. He understands color and how to make things hang together. I have a theme of geometry and shapes going on in my house. He has helped me achieve this balance between consistency while having some aberrations and surprises. He also did a good job understanding my budget and what items to lean on in terms of quality and design and which ones to not stretch the budget on.

Overall, I am very impressed with Studio Goldfinch’s work and their expertise. I will definitely work with them for all my future interior design projects.

I will add photos at a later date.
